# LinkGuard Platform
Fast, secure URL shortener with real-time analytics, privacy protection (SHA-256 IP anonymization), and customizable QR code studio.

## Core APIs
- GET /{shortCode} - Resolves 302 Found redirect
- POST /api/v1/urls - Creates short URL or custom slug
- GET /api/v1/analytics/{id} - Returns click analytics and distribution
- POST /api/v1/qr-codes - Generates custom PNG/SVG QR codes
